scope: All final vector A/B/C runs under outputs_rafm_input_study with training_stats at the prescribed final update; excludes sanity, plots, active/incomplete training and audio/image

diagnostic_threshold.selection: descriptive screening threshold, not a theorem, protocol change, or metric-validity criterion

limitations: Only existing logging checkpoints are observed; unlogged minibatch spikes may be missed.
A high batch MSE can reflect targets, model predictions, or both; threshold alone does not prove a numerical cause.
Known inherited antipodal mechanism is established separately by source/scalar analysis, not by replay of these minibatches.
Below-threshold runs are not certified free of numerical path errors.
Quality metrics and original complete/failed statuses are preserved; this audit does not invalidate finite metrics solely by threshold.
